festivals/prox.html: PROX is a music festival running from midday through to the following morning at DAN OISO, a site in Oiso, Kanagawa, born out of a renovated farm plot. After a daytime run of live sets, the focus shifts at 23:00 to the covered arch-shaped stage, where DJs take over. SUNGA, Dazzle Drums, カワムラユキ and others link up the sounds as the dancing carries on until 5 a.m. Come to camp, or just turn up for the night. On land that was once farmland, it's a single night where music, place and different scenes intersect.
